name: Inverse IFEval
abstract: Inverse IFEval studies whether models can break stubborn training conventions and still follow real instructions. This page uses the Overall Score from the English main table.
method: This work goes beyond conventional formatting compliance and explicitly designs inverse instructions that conflict with common training conventions.
The tasks test whether models can still obey real user intent under correction, counter-conventional formatting, dialogue intervention, and minimal-modification requirements.
The results show that even the strongest models still have clear weaknesses on inverse instruction following.
